mapper.select: select ct.id, ct.clinic_id as orgId, btbtc.tariffCategoryId, btbtc.tariffCategoryName, btbtc.tariffCategoryNumber, btbtc.tariffId, btbtc.`name`, btbtc.englishName, btbtc.`number`, btbtc.unit, ct.price, ct.inservice from clinic_tariff ct left join ( select bt.id as tariffId, btc.id as tariffCategoryId, btc.`name` as tariffCategoryName, btc.number as tariffCategoryNumber, bt.item_number as number, bt.`name`, bt.english_name as englishName, bt.unit from base_tariff bt left join base_tariff_category btc on bt.tariff_category_id = btc.id ) btbtc on ct.tariff_id = btbtc.tariffId where id = #{clinicTariffId}
